stem: Histories of the Roman period written by contemporaries were usually called 'Annals'. Why?
options: They were written only on papyrus rolls

explanation: Correct option: (B). Contemporary histories were called 'Annals' because the narrative was constructed on a year-by-year basis. The name has nothing to do with the writing material (papyrus), inscriptions on stone, or a Senate archive.
